Class_Skill_Desc_Deadly Blow: Delivers an attack with a potency of 200.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Potency increases by up to 250 as your HP decreases</br>Additional Effect: Potency increases by up to 2,000 based on the amount of damage taken while under the effect of Pent-up Rage
Class_Skill_Desc_Rage: Become enraged, delivering an attack with a potency of 150 to all enemies in a cone before you.</br>Potency scales with item level. Immune to certain status effects, as well as most knockback and draw-in effects.</br>Duration: 10s</br>Additional Effect: Grants Pent-up Rage</br>Pent-up Rage Effect: Increases the potency of Deadly Blow based on the amount of damage taken while this effect is active
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Rage: Grants the effect of Pent-up Rage, increasing the potency of Deadly Blow based on the amount of damage you have taken while the effect is active.</br>Duration: 15s
